lines.text: The LORD says heaven is His throne and earth is His footstool, and He esteems the humble.
The LORD says those who chose their own ways will receive punishment, because He called and no one answered.
Brothers who hate those trembling at His word because of the LORD's name will be put to shame.
The LORD says that as soon as Babylon was in labor, she gave birth to her children.
The LORD will extend peace to Jerusalem like a river, and His people will flourish like a cedar of Lebanon.
